statuses.implemented: behavior fully working and tested in this build (in-process/loopback transports where the spec names a wire protocol)
statuses.partial: core mechanism working and tested; a named sub-aspect is stubbed, simulated, or reduced in scope
statuses.deferred: cannot be completed in this offline sandbox (no network egress, no cluster, no external SDKs) or is an organizational/process item; disposition and forward path documented

requirements.requirement: Compose, don't replace: adapters/extensions over new wire formats
requirements.evidence: protoos/mcp.py, a2a.py, wallet.py, commerce.py; all adapter tests
requirements.notes: No new wire format introduced; Unified Agent Card is a superset manifest, not a protocol.

requirements.requirement: Policy-first autonomy: every tool call, delegation, payment through policy engine with cryptographic mandates and audit trails
requirements.evidence: protoos/policy.py, core.py:_gate, wallet.py:precheck; tests test_G2_*, test_I3_*, test_M1_*
requirements.notes: Sensitive actions default-deny; every decision written to hash-chained audit.

requirements.requirement: Layered sovereignty: fully local/enterprise, federated, and open-internet (ANP/DID) modes
requirements.notes: Open mode publishes /.well-known/agent.json and did:web docs to a local root — live internet resolution deferred (egress disabled).

requirements.requirement: Kubernetes-native by default, with optional lighter-weight runtimes
requirements.evidence: deploy/k8s/crds.yaml + control-plane.yaml; registry.py CRD-shaped records; the whole package runs as the lighter-weight runtime
requirements.notes: CRDs and Deployment manifests provided and CRD shapes exercised in tests; applying to a live cluster deferred (no cluster in sandbox).

requirements.requirement: Multi-rail everything: tools (MCP), messaging (A2A+ANP), payments (x402+MPP+traditional), identity (DIDs+TAP+enterprise IdP)
requirements.evidence: mcp.py, a2a.py, wallet.py rails, identity.py EnterpriseIdPStub; tests test_T1_*, test_R1_*, test_M1/M4_*, test_I2_*

requirements.requirement: Human-in-the-loop as a first-class primitive (AG-UI + mandate types)
requirements.evidence: core.py PendingApproval/_gate/approve, a2a.py HUMAN_INPUT_* events; tests test_M1_E2E_large_purchase_requires_human_then_settles, test_U2_E2E_human_declines_no_money_moves
requirements.notes: require_approval is a policy effect; approvals stream over AG-UI and resolve/settle atomically.

requirements.requirement: Open governance under a Linux-Foundation-style neutral foundation from day one
requirements.notes: Organizational/legal process; cannot be executed by software in a sandbox. Charter draft included.

requirements.requirement: Control plane: Policy Engine + Mandate Store
Control plane: Orchestrator / Task Graph
requirements.evidence: runtime.py TaskGraph, core.py run/delegate; tests test_R3_taskgraph_dag_order_and_cycle, TestOrchestration

requirements.requirement: Control plane: Identity & Credential Service
Control plane: Discovery & Registry
Control plane: Observability & Audit
Control plane: Wallet / Spending Controller
Protocol adapter tier: MCP, A2A, AGP / AP2, x402, MPP, TAP / UCP-ACP / AG-UI, ANP, DIDs
requirements.evidence: mcp.py, a2a.py, wallet.py, commerce.py, identity.py, registry.py; all adapter tests
requirements.notes: All named surfaces have working reference-shaped, in-process adapters. AGP appears as routing inspiration (rank_candidates), not a wire adapter; adapters are not certified conformant against published external specs (egress disabled).

requirements.requirement: Application layer: agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK, ARC/LMOS DSLs) on top
requirements.evidence: core.py OSContext + A2A handler contract; every e2e test agent is written against it
requirements.notes: Stable handler/OSContext contract any framework can target; concrete third-party bindings deferred (packages not installable offline).

requirements.requirement: Identity: W3C DIDs (did:web, did:key, ANP did:wba variants) + Verifiable Credentials
requirements.notes: did:proto is a did:key-style key-hash method; did:web/wba documents publish to a local well-known root — live HTTP resolution deferred (egress disabled).

requirements.requirement: Bridge to enterprise: OAuth 2.1 / OIDC + TAP-style agent identity
requirements.notes: OIDC-shaped assertion -> Proto session token with act provenance; full OAuth 2.1 flows against a real IdP deferred.

requirements.requirement: AP2 Mandates (Intent, Cart, Payment) as first-class objects stored and verified by the OS
requirements.notes: Chain checks: signatures, linkage, totals, intent max, categories, currency, expiry.

requirements.requirement: Cryptographic identity at creation; short-lived session credentials; RFC 8693-style token exchange
requirements.evidence: identity.py issue_token/exchange_token/revoke_token, core.py create_agent; tests test_I4_*
requirements.notes: Ed25519 in this environment; OS-verified HMAC fallback when `cryptography` is absent.

requirements.requirement: Unified Agent Card / Capability Manifest — superset of A2A cards, MCP manifests, UCP profiles, ANP/LMOS descriptions (JSON-LD preferred)
requirements.notes: JSON-LD-lite: @context field carried; full JSON-LD expansion not required by any consumer in this build.

requirements.requirement: Multi-backend registry: local Kubernetes CRDs (LMOS-style), federated directories (AGNTCY-like), open search (ANP), well-known URLs
requirements.notes: Well-known served over loopback HTTP too.

requirements.requirement: Semantic + vector search over capabilities under policy constraints
requirements.evidence: registry.py SemanticIndex (TF-IDF cosine) with `where` filter; tests test_D3_*
requirements.notes: Vectorization is TF-IDF (stdlib); swapping in learned embeddings is an isolated seam (requires model download — egress disabled).

requirements.requirement: Task and workflow model extending the A2A Task lifecycle
Hierarchical routing inspired by AGP: capability announcements, policy matching, cost-aware selection
requirements.evidence: registry.py rank_candidates + SemanticIndex.where, core.py discover; tests test_R2_cost_aware_ranking, test_D3_R2_discover_then_select_by_cost
requirements.notes: Capability+policy+cost selection implemented; multi-tier AGP gateway topology/announcement gossip deferred.

requirements.requirement: Supervisor agents or declarative graphs delegate via A2A while the OS enforces budgets and policies
requirements.evidence: core.py delegate (policy gate, budget slices), runtime.py TaskGraph; test_R3_E2E_delegate_with_budget_slice

requirements.requirement: Native support for short-lived tasks and long-running sessions
requirements.evidence: a2a.py input-required parking/resume, runtime.py SessionManager; tests test_R1_input_required_resume_long_running, test_R4_session_manager_long_running

requirements.requirement: First-class MCP client and server support, including paid MCP tools via x402/MPP wrappers
requirements.evidence: mcp.py MCPServer/MCPClient, core.py call_tool auto-payment; tests test_T1_*, test_M1_E2E_paid_tool_autopays_x402_under_budget, test_M4_E2E_paid_tool_via_mpp_session
requirements.notes: 402-coded error carries an x402 challenge; OS pays via budgeted x402 or an MPP session and retries.

requirements.requirement: Automatic OpenAPI -> MCP conversion and federation of multiple MCP servers
requirements.notes: Converter accepts a live transport; default offline transport returns structured simulated calls (egress disabled).

requirements.requirement: Resource and prompt caching with policy-based access control
Unified spending controller: AP2 authorization, then settlement via x402 (crypto/micro), MPP (multi-rail/sessions), or traditional rails
requirements.evidence: wallet.py SpendingController.precheck/settle + three rails; tests test_M1_*
requirements.notes: Facilitator/clearing are in-process simulations; connecting real crypto or banking networks deferred (egress disabled).

requirements.requirement: UCP/ACP for product discovery and checkout flows
requirements.evidence: commerce.py Catalog.search/checkout feeding CartMandates; purchase-flow e2e tests
requirements.notes: Reference-shaped; not certified against external UCP/ACP specs.

requirements.requirement: Built-in budget hierarchies, category controls, time windows, cumulative limits
requirements.notes: Spend rolls up ancestors; windows are rolling.

requirements.requirement: MPP-style sessions for high-frequency tool or API use
AG-UI as the standard event stream to frontends
requirements.evidence: a2a.py AGUIBus, httpapi.py SSE endpoint; tests TestAGUI, test_X4_http_jsonrpc_wellknown_and_sse

requirements.requirement: Generative UI patterns, shared state, human approvals, multi-client (web, mobile, terminal, chat)
requirements.evidence: AGUIBus state deltas + multi-subscriber, approvals over the stream; tests test_U1/U2_*
requirements.notes: Shared state, approvals and multi-client subscription implemented; rendered generative-UI component library deferred (event payloads carry the data).

requirements.requirement: Declarative policy language (CEL-like) + higher-level DSL, evaluated on every sensitive action
requirements.evidence: policy.py safe_eval (whitelisted AST) + Rule schema; tests test_G1_*
requirements.notes: No eval(); attribute access, calls and arithmetic are rejected.

requirements.requirement: Four-layer policy stack: platform, legal/jurisdictional, organization, personal/user
requirements.evidence: policy.py LAYERS + deny-overrides precedence; tests test_G2_*

requirements.requirement: Complete hash-chained audit log of every mandate, tool call, delegation and payment
requirements.evidence: audit.py AuditLog.verify; emission sites across policy/wallet/core/a2a; tests test_G3_*
requirements.notes: Tamper detection returns the first bad index.

requirements.requirement: Sandboxing, rate limits, and kill switches
requirements.notes: Rate limits and scoped/global kill switches fully implemented; sandboxing is in-process capability scoping — OS/container-level isolation deferred to the production runtime.

requirements.requirement: OpenTelemetry everywhere + agent-specific traces (task graphs, tool latency, settlement, policy decisions)
requirements.evidence: audit.py Tracer spans over run/tool/purchase/graph; tests test_O1_*; export via ProtoOS.export
requirements.notes: OTel-shaped spans exported as JSONL; OTLP network exporter deferred (egress disabled).

requirements.requirement: Control plane in Rust
requirements.notes: cargo cannot fetch crates offline and std-only Rust lacks JSON/HTTP. The Python reference is the executable specification; module boundaries mirror the intended Rust services.

requirements.requirement: Pluggable agent runtimes (Python/TS preferred)
requirements.evidence: Python runtime throughout; A2A handler contract is language-neutral over the HTTP JSON-RPC surface
requirements.notes: TypeScript runtime deferred (npm registry unreachable).

requirements.requirement: Storage: etcd/Postgres control plane; object storage + vector DB for manifests and memory
requirements.evidence: In-memory stores + JSONL/well-known file persistence; storage touchpoints isolated per subsystem
requirements.notes: No etcd/Postgres/object-store services in sandbox; swap-in points documented in README.

requirements.requirement: Transport: HTTP/JSON-RPC + SSE baseline
requirements.notes: Loopback only (egress disabled).

requirements.requirement: gRPC and QUIC optional transports
requirements.notes: Explicitly optional in spec; grpcio/QUIC libs not installable offline.

requirements.requirement: Crypto: standard libraries + existing x402/MPP/AP2 SDKs
requirements.evidence: Ed25519 via `cryptography` (standard library-grade), HMAC fallback; rails implemented natively
requirements.notes: Official external x402/MPP/AP2 SDKs unavailable offline; native implementations follow the flows described in the spec document.

requirements.requirement: Open-source under Apache 2.0 (or equivalent), neutral-foundation governed
requirements.notes: License applied; foundation formation is an organizational process (see P7).

requirements.requirement: Constellation graph model: derive nodes/edges (principals, budgets, servers/tools, mandates, receipts, tasks, approvals)
Deterministic force layout: identical worlds and seeds produce identical constellations; velocity-clamped, finite
Constellation exports: JSON, Graphviz DOT, standalone SVG snapshot in the ledger palette
Obsidian vault export: every identity, budget, mandate, receipt, and task becomes a wikilinked markdown note; policy/audit/feed tables; dir or zip
Vault link integrity: all [[wikilinks]] resolve to existing notes; no private key material exported
Vault reflects ledger truth: audit table row-for-row with the hash chain, verdict recomputed at export
